label: preparing
what: A secret jubilee celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the town hall great hall: 200 fresh loaves on feast tables and eight lanterns. Freight, innkeeper and builder coordinated supplies, baking, lighting and delivery. Baker knowingly donated 132 wheat and free oven use; neighbour carried bread and arranged to bring the mayor without revealing the surprise. No record shows the mayor being told about the jubilee; secretary overheard bread logistics but is not shown knowingly helping the secret celebration.
